discovery_notes: Cell B353, follow-up 5 of B015 (packets 215, 422, 464, 496, 519); reuses their keys. 28 standard searches, snippets only; many values from search-engine summaries (noted per claim). Released: HKDL 13th anniversary phase 2 five on per-design captions quoted in results. New: six Pin Trading Carnival 2018 park-festival designer pins, five food-truck HM designs, ambassador pin design, 13th anniversary birthday giveaway, Walt Disney birthday 2018 Pooh, HK$78 classic PWP set, SHDR CNY 2018 LE and mystery sets; TDS Christmas tree pin 1,000 yen. Resellers (carousell, belloshophk, castleplanethk, parkscollectibles, wizmouse, Yahoo auctions) and YouTube ignored.
